gw_xray.cut_note: VLESS will reconnect for everyone for a couple of seconds: the gateway’s xray was restarted so that a revoked or disabled device is cut off at once
gw_xray.log.api_file: GW xray: the file for the API wasn’t written ({err}) — restarting
gw_xray.log.api_refused: GW xray: the API rejected {cmd} ({err}) — restarting
gw_xray.log.api_slow: GW xray: API calls over {s} s — a restart instead of the API
gw_xray.log.fetch_failed: GW xray: download for the gateway failed — {why}
gw_xray.log.fetched: GW xray: downloaded for the gateway ({path})
gw_xray.log.hot: GW xray: no restart — clients +{au} −{ru}, rules +{ar} −{rr}
gw_xray.log.lock_timeout: GW xray: the lock of xray changes was busy over {s} s — the collector applies the changes within 20 s
gw_xray.log.no_xports: GW xray: no gw_xports set in the table — the new xray config is not applied, the previous one runs; the table goes first (gw apply)
gw_xray.log.ru_closed: GW xray: the new config is not applied and the previous one sent Russia directly for users who no longer get it ({n}) — xray stopped, the previous config file deleted
gw_xray.log.ru_guard: GW: the last line (D-136) — {where}: Russia direct without the ⚠RU confirmation ({n}) is not applied
gw_xray.log.ru_left: GW xray: the previous config file with Russia direct ({n}) couldn’t be removed — the mark is kept: the next call closes again
gw_xray.log.ru_open: GW xray: the new config is not applied, the previous one may send Russia directly for users who no longer get it ({n}), and xray did not stop (disable --now, stop, kill) — the mark is kept: the next call closes again
gw_xray.log.user: GW xray: created the system user {user} (uid {uid})
gw_xray.no_xray: No xray for the gateway: kaskadctl gw apply will download it (or turn on “Telegram API proxy” in the gokaskad menu — it installs xray).
gw_xray.no_xray_fetch: No xray for the gateway (SOCKS5, the VLESS protocol and VLESS exits need it): couldn’t download it from GitHub ({why}). Check that the server can reach github.com and try again.
gw_xray.port.busy: port {addr}:{port}/{proto} ({what}, gateway xray) is in use: {who} — free it (stop or reconfigure that program) and try again
gw_xray.port.pool_socks: the pool’s SOCKS port for “Check link”
gw_xray.prepare_failed: the gateway xray couldn’t be prepared: {err}
gw_xray.ru_guard: the gateway xray config is not applied: it sends Russia directly ({n}) without the ⚠RU confirmation. This must not happen — it is a Kaskad fault: Russia is closed, please tell the developers
gw_xray.site_failed: the site didn’t move behind xray (VLESS + TLS on 443): {err}
gw_xray.user_failed: couldn’t create the system user {user} for the gateway’s xray: {err}
gw_xray.warn.no_xports: xray not updated: the nft table has no gw_xports set; xray catches up on its own once the table is applied — details in the log
gw_xray.warn.ru_closed: The gateway xray is stopped: the new config is not applied, and the previous one sent Russia directly for users who no longer get it under the new settings (“Russia direct” or the ⚠RU confirmation removed, another route, the device or the user disabled or deleted). SOCKS5, the VLESS protocol and VLESS exits don’t work until xray takes the new config: fix the cause and run kaskadctl gw apply.
gw_xray.warn.ru_closed_xports: The gateway xray is stopped: the nft table has no gw_xports set, so the new config is not applied, and the previous one sent Russia directly for users who no longer get it under the new settings. SOCKS5, the VLESS protocol and VLESS exits don’t work until the table is applied: run kaskadctl gw apply, details in the log.
gw_xray.warn.ru_file_left: The previous config file couldn’t be removed either — check the disk (/etc/kaskad/gw); the watchdog won’t start xray with that file.
gw_xray.warn.ru_open: Couldn’t stop the gateway xray: the new config is not applied, and the previous one may still send Russia directly for users who no longer get it under the new settings. Kaskad tried disable, stop and kill. Stop the xray process by hand or reboot the server, then run kaskadctl gw apply. Until then the collector tries to close it again on every tick.
gw_xray.warn.ru_stopped_left: The gateway xray is stopped, but the previous config file couldn’t be removed: it sends Russia directly for users who no longer get it under the new settings. The watchdog won’t start xray with that file. Check the disk (/etc/kaskad/gw) and run kaskadctl gw apply.
gw_xray.why.recent: the last attempt failed less than 10 minutes ago
gw_xray.write_failed: couldn’t write the gateway xray config: {err}
